doc.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020

title: Residuals and the Safeway commercial checks
summary: Bergeron explains commercial payment cycles and the stack of Safeway buyout checks that arrived.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: I was wondering how you — I mean are there certain things that, from what I know, that you get residuals for and things, but others you don’t. Would you know if you were supposed to be getting residuals and you didn’t?
You mean if somebody was being dishonest?
Yeah, if you were supposed to be getting payments for something, are you organized enough that you know?

There’s no way I could keep track of that. So what they do, I mean it depends. Like for a commercial let’s say, a television commercial. They get 13 weeks before they have to give you another payment. And then you get 75% of your original payment. So if you do a commercial that runs for 13 weeks and that’s it, you don’t get any more money. If it runs another cycle you’ll get another payment, and then another payment. Now depending on how many spots they made out of it, like there’s been a couple of commercials that have been very lucrative for me. I still get paid from a Jack in the Box commercial I did in 1994. It’s not much, I still get a couple of checks you know. It’s like unbelievable, it’s still running somewhere. But I did a Safeway commercial, Safeway supermarkets, I don’t know if they have those where you’re at. But, and we had to play “The Way You Look Tonight” but more like “Cute” with a Harmon muted trumpet, bass and drums. So it went [scats] you know it was like “Cute.” And that was for the jingle. And I didn’t think too much about it. We did that thing, and then in my mailbox about 13 weeks later my mailbox was stuffed with rubber bands around them, of these checks. And I didn’t know what it was and I’m like oh my God. And I’m opening these checks up, and they’re for this Safeway commercial. Now usually you would just see a couple of checks, right? Because they had two spots or something. Well what they decided to do was buy us out for the year of all the regions. So instead of cutting just one check though, the system doesn’t work that way, so they cut individual checks. So I got all these checks © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
